topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I can’t help but feel a bit heavy knowing that the invention you've been working on is already patented. I should have checked the patent databases earlier to save you this trouble. Now, it's important we focus on the path forward. Let’s take a step back and look at the details. There might be unique aspects of your design that could still be novel and patentable. We can also explore partnerships or licensing opportunities. Your creativity and hard work shouldn’t go to waste. I’m here to support you in finding the best next steps.
